sketchMechanisms: Goroutine leak — a goroutine that sends on a channel no one will ever receive from blocks forever, never garbage collected, never terminated
The 'never' return type — a function typed as returning 'never' is one that can never successfully complete; TypeScript enforces that no value can inhabit this type
A finalize() method that resurrects the object by re-registering a strong reference to it, preventing garbage collection — the object refuses to die but finalize is only called once
